notes.title: Infinite Game Works Ep 1 Features coming to Ep 0, New UI
notes.content: Hi everyone! This is announcing that we'll be bringing features planned for Ep 1 to Ep 0. This will be things like the following. - [u]NEW UI[/u] - Moods - Holidays (May trigger moods in characters, no CG) - Sick events - Actions/Skills that directly trigger story events. They won't be as fleshed out as we're planning for Ep 1. However it should be a breath of fresh air for existing players. While seems like an early access game, in truth it was released in 2011. So we can't quite call it that. Look forward to it!

notes.title: Infinite Game Works Ep 1 Features coming to Ep 0, New UI
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

This is announcing that we'll be bringing features planned for Ep 1 to Ep 0. This will be things like the following. 

- [b][u]NEW UI[/u][/b]
- Moods
- Holidays (May trigger moods in characters, no CG)
- Sick events
- Actions/Skills that directly trigger story events.

They won't be as fleshed out as we're planning for Ep 1. However it should be a breath of fresh air for existing players.

While seems like an early access game, in truth it was released in 2011. So we can't quite call it that.

Look forward to it!
